title: One Last Job (Cruz and Leana)
concept: A modern open-world crime game look with original characters. Cruz is almost a millionaire with one more job, and his real LifeFlow day runs the mission: net worth at sunrise, the car at 11, ticking off 'Send Lorenza $50,000', dinner at 6, the casino at 8. 'Can I get this?'
